description: TfL publishes the polygon boundary of the London Congestion Charging Zone. The source says the boundary follows the deposited plans signed off by the London Mayor. It represents the area of a road-charging control, not a time series of charge payments, traffic volumes or compliance. The boundary can delimit policy scenarios when combined with independently sourced road and travel-demand inputs. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
